gloss: mutual love; feelings that are returned

definitions.explanation: A situation in which two people love each other, especially when a crush turns out to be returned. Also written {両想|りょうおも}い.

examples.japanese: ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{両思|りょうおも}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧なれた。
examples.english: At last our feelings are mutual.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{両想|りょうおも}いだった。
examples.english: The two of them actually liked each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{告白|こくはく}したら→告白する：19631_kokuhakusuru⟧、{両思|りょうおも}いだったこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わかった。
examples.english: When I worked up the courage to confess, I found out the feeling was mutual.

notes:
A casual word, common among young people and in manga and pop songs. The spelling {両想|りょうおも}い is just as common and feels a little more romantic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {両思|りょうおも}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become mutual (of love)
- ⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{両思|りょうおも}い: actually in love with each other
- {両想|りょうおも}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カップル→カップル：19414_kappuru⟧: a couple who love each other

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{片思|かたおも}い→片思い：16834_kataomoi⟧: one-sided love, an unreturned crush — the opposite
- {相思相愛|そうしそうあい}: mutual love — a more formal four-character idiom
